column1: # Game profile of AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.1 = v65536). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Unity 2017.4.17f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 6.4.2; subsdk0 is the movie module, which plays the game's 168 movies (MP4 of H.264 and AAC, StreamingAssets/Movie) through Unity's video player:
# NV12 frames into CPU buffers, copied to an R8 + RG8 texture pair each frame (nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture). The shaders are Shader objects in the AssetBundles of StreamingAssets
# (read by shader_split.py through unityfs.py, Cuphead's Unity 2017.4 layout); 3 geometry shaders (Unity's DX11 depth of field, a wireframe effect) do not build, none was drawn in play.
# The Spike Chunsoft logo movie held the game before the title until the H.264 drain went on at ReleaseOutputBufferIndex (hle_movie.c): Unity holds all 16 video outputs at the end of a movie.
# Controller only: docked (the game draws 1280x720 by its own choice and crops the 1920x1080 window to it), with the 3D pad layout, as the investigation moves its cursor with the left stick
# and the view with the right one. It presents at interval 1 (60 fps).

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# the right stick moves the view in the investigation
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: Unity sets a heap of the application pool − used memory (3.11 GB) and allocates from it
# (Mac: 2.27 GB resident over 5 minutes from boot to the first investigation, flat). The block is 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region
# the rewritten modules take more than the default 64 MB of used memory: with 64 MB the heap request plus the modules exceeds the pool and SetHeapSize fails (as Cuphead)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects, read by unityfs.py) ----
